audit.why: Akali owning 1-3, skill at 4-5, Master Yi taking 6 and first item, Akali back at two items matches 49.19% Emerald+ over 431 games and the on-disk chart. Chart untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-4 row credited his catch-up to 'his Wuju Style points' without saying what Wuju Style does, and the level-6 row called Alpha Strike 'his Q dash'.
audit.why: Wuju Style is a flat 14s that adds true damage to his basics - that is the spike, and it is why no defensive item you buy changes the trade. Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s, and its cooldown is reduced by his basic attacks, so it comes back faster the longer he is hitting something. Highlander is a flat 85s.
audit.corrected: whys[3], whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid rebuilt on the true damage, the 20s Alpha Strike and the 85s Highlander.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions were absent, and one that was stated does not exist: the page twice said Akali's passive heals her.
audit.why: Akali's Assassin's Mark grants bonus attack range and damage on an auto-reset - there is no heal anywhere in her kit, so 'poke-and-heal' was inventing sustain the player does not have. What actually decides the matchup and was missing: Highlander makes Master Yi immune to slows, so Five Point Strike's slow does nothing while it runs; Alpha Strike makes him untargetable for the whole dash, so a committed burst can whiff entirely; and Wuju Style's true damage ignores every resistance you buy.
audit.corrected: early, whys[0], whys[1], whys[3], whys[4], whys[5], mid, spikes[1].text, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1] rewritten - the heal claim is deleted and the slow immunity, untargetability and true damage are stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the entry mentioned anti-heal.
audit.why: Meditate is a flat 10s channel that restores health and reduces damage taken, so uncommitted poke into a Yi who can just sit down and channel is wasted gold. Grievous Wounds before his first item is what makes the chip stick - the _missing file flags this matchup needs-antiheal on Meditate.
audit.corrected: whys[5] now names Meditate and the anti-heal requirement.

Chip him off every wave, threaten the flip whenever he steps up to CS, and build a health-and-gold lead now — the middle of this game belongs to him.
edits.after: Bully him. Your Q out-pokes him at 1-2 and level 3 adds the E mark-and-burst he simply cannot answer pre-item. edits.after: Master Yi takes level 6: Highlander makes him immune to your Q slow while it runs, and Alpha Strike goes untargetable straight through your burst. Keep distance.
